status: Self-check working record; independent audit Open

outcomes.definition: Complete only verified authority-package gaps while retaining valid existing sources.
outcomes.acceptance_test: Every required record is classified as reused, gap, and canonical completion with no silent replacement.
outcomes.evidence: Gap audit plus exact diff and hashes.

outcomes.definition: A replacement AI resumes the same unfinished task from a confirmed remote checkpoint.
outcomes.acceptance_test: Interrupted checkpoint resumes first unfinished phase; following task is rejected.
outcomes.evidence: Hostile test output and remote readback.

outcomes.definition: Task states and transitions distinguish active, interrupted, self-check, audit, verified, accepted, failed, Open, and contaminated states.
outcomes.acceptance_test: Every legal transition passes and every undeclared transition fails.

outcomes.definition: Dependent work fails closed for unfinished, unaudited, failed, blocking-Open, or contaminated prerequisites.
outcomes.acceptance_test: One rejection fixture for each blocking prerequisite state.
outcomes.evidence: Validator output naming blocker and permitted next action.

outcomes.definition: A context-free AI receives a short truthful block/safe-switch notice and exact next action.
outcomes.acceptance_test: Fresh-context fixture requests a locked task and receives the required projection.
outcomes.evidence: Rendered output matched to machine state.

outcomes.definition: Staging remains untrusted and integration is the protected accepted baseline.
outcomes.acceptance_test: Commit/self-check on staging cannot create accepted dependency; direct integration mutation fails.
outcomes.evidence: Adversarial validator results and ruleset evidence.

outcomes.definition: Machine enforcement covers task, branch, scope, record freshness, dependencies, traceability, evidence, authority, and prohibited drift where deterministic.
outcomes.acceptance_test: Positive fixture and one negative fixture per deterministic control.

outcomes.definition: An author cannot independently verify or accept its own load-bearing result.
outcomes.acceptance_test: Same-actor and missing-review attempts fail; separate valid review can pass verification only.
outcomes.evidence: Reviewer-identity fixtures and retained review schema.

outcomes.definition: Invalidated upstream work propagates potential contamination to all relying descendants until resolved.
outcomes.acceptance_test: Multi-level lineage fixture marks all descendants and blocks their use.
outcomes.evidence: Before/after lineage state and validator results.

outcomes.definition: Recovery identifies the last verified baseline without destructive or unauthorized repository action.
outcomes.acceptance_test: Unsafe/stale fixture emits baseline and recovery action without reset, force, merge, or deletion.
outcomes.evidence: Recovery output and unchanged protected refs.

outcomes.definition: Hostile tests cover every required rejection and recovery case without weakening retained G0 tests.
outcomes.acceptance_test: All G1 hostile cases and the retained 18 G0 cases pass with actual results recorded.
outcomes.evidence: Complete test output, integrity, diff, and applicable repository checks.

outcomes.definition: External event-triggered AI review remains optional, provider-neutral, and non-authoritative.
outcomes.acceptance_test: Blocking/resumption fixtures pass with no external reviewer service configured.
outcomes.evidence: Offline validator run and configuration inspection.
